import MumfordLib.SourceComplexUniformization
import MumfordLib.FundamentalGroupEquivalence
import MumfordLib.FundamentalGroupPeriodLoops
import MumfordLib.FundamentalGroupTransport

/-!
# The fundamental group and the intrinsic period lattice

The source uniformization supplies a based homeomorphism from the full-lattice
quotient to the original compact connected complex Lie group. Transporting the
lifted-endpoint isomorphism along it identifies the fundamental group with the
kernel of the intrinsic exponential.

Reference: Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, Chapter I, Section 1, p. 3, the first
step in the proof of the integral-cohomology assertion.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped Topology Manifold ContDiff IsMulCommutative

namespace Mumford.Analytic

open Uniformization ComplexVectorLatticeExponentialData

variable {E H G : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H)
  [TopologicalSpace G] [ChartedSpace H G] [Group G]
  [LieGroup I ω G] [T2Space G] [I.Boundaryless]
  [CompactSpace G] [PreconnectedSpace G]

/-- The geometric based loop obtained by exponentiating the segment from zero
to an intrinsic period. -/
def compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I → Path (1 : G) 1 := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  intro u
  refine
    { toFun := fun t => intrinsicComplexExponential (G := G) I
        ((t : ℝ) • (u : GroupLieAlgebra I G))
      continuous_toFun := ?_
      source' := by simp
      target' := ?_ }
  · change Continuous (fun t : unitInterval => canonicalComplexExponential (G := G) I
      ((t : ℝ) • ((complexLieAlgebraEquiv (G := G) I).symm u)))
    exact (canonicalComplexExponential_continuous (G := G) I).comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.smul continuous_const)
  · simpa using
      (intrinsicComplexExponential_eq_one_iff_mem_periodLattice (G := G) I u).mpr u.property

@[simp]
theorem compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop_apply :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∀ (u : intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) (t : unitInterval),
      compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop (G := G) I u t =
        intrinsicComplexExponential (G := G) I ((t : ℝ) • (u : GroupLieAlgebra I G)) := by
  intros
  rfl

/-- The lifted-endpoint equivalence sends the geometric loop of each intrinsic
period to that period. All data are derived from the original Lie group. -/
theorem exists_compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∃ e : FundamentalGroup G 1 ≃*
        Multiplicative (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I),
      ∀ (u : intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) (γ : Path (1 : G) 1),
        (∀ t, γ t = intrinsicComplexExponential (G := G) I
          ((t : ℝ) • (u : GroupLieAlgebra I G))) →
        ((e (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk γ))).toAdd : GroupLieAlgebra I G) = u := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  let e : E ≃ₗ[ℂ] GroupLieAlgebra I G := complexLieAlgebraEquiv (G := G) I
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (GroupLieAlgebra I G) :=
    NormedAddCommGroup.induced _ _
      e.symm.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom e.symm.injective
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (GroupLieAlgebra I G) :=
    NormedSpace.induced ℂ _ _ e.symm.toLinearMap
  letI : UniformSpace (GroupLieAlgebra I G) :=
    @PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace (GroupLieAlgebra I G) inferInstance
  letI : TopologicalSpace (GroupLieAlgebra I G) :=
    @UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace (GroupLieAlgebra I G) inferInstance
  obtain ⟨coordinate, hperiod, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, f, hfm, hadd⟩ :=
    compactComplexLieGroup_uniformization (G := G) I
  let d := intrinsicComplexVectorLatticeExponentialData (G := G) I coordinate
  letI : ChartedSpace (GroupLieAlgebra I G)
      (GroupLieAlgebra I G ⧸ d.ambientPeriodLattice) := analyticQuotientChartedSpace d
  have hf : f 0 = 1 := by
    apply mul_left_cancel (a := f 0)
    simpa using (hadd 0 0).symm
  let ef := fundamentalGroupHomeomorphEquiv f.toHomeomorph hf
  have h : ∃ e : FundamentalGroup G 1 ≃* Multiplicative d.ambientPeriodLattice,
      ∀ (u : d.ambientPeriodLattice) (γ : Path (1 : G) 1),
        (∀ t, γ t = intrinsicComplexExponential (G := G) I
          ((t : ℝ) • (u : GroupLieAlgebra I G))) →
        ((e (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk γ))).toAdd : GroupLieAlgebra I G) = u := by
    refine ⟨ef.symm.trans (quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv d), ?_⟩
    intro u γ hγ
    have hclass : FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk γ) =
        ef (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (quotientPeriodLoop d u)) := by
      change FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk γ) =
        FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨f.toHomeomorph, f.toHomeomorph.continuous⟩ hf
          (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk (quotientPeriodLoopPath d u)))
      rw [FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq_apply]
      apply congrArg (fun p : Path (1 : G) 1 => FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk p))
      ext t
      change γ t = f (quotientPeriodLoopPath d u t)
      rw [quotientPeriodLoopPath_apply, hfm]
      exact hγ t
    change ((quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv d
      (ef.symm (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk γ)))).toAdd : GroupLieAlgebra I G) = u
    rw [hclass, ef.symm_apply_apply]
    exact quotientFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv_quotientPeriodLoop d u
  rw [hperiod] at h
  exact h

/-- The fundamental group at the identity is the intrinsic exponential period
lattice, normalized by geometric exponential loops. -/
def compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    FundamentalGroup G 1 ≃*
      Multiplicative (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) :=
  (exists_compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).choose

/-- A period is the image of its geometric exponential loop under the
fundamental-group comparison. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv_apply_exponentialLoop :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∀ (u : intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) (γ : Path (1 : G) 1),
      (∀ t, γ t = intrinsicComplexExponential (G := G) I
        ((t : ℝ) • (u : GroupLieAlgebra I G))) →
      ((compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I
        (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk γ))).toAdd : GroupLieAlgebra I G) = u :=
  (exists_compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).choose_spec

/- The additive presentation is the form consumed by integral cohomology:
   characters of the fundamental group become linear maps on the period
   lattice.  It is derived from the multiplicative equivalence above, so no
   additional choice of generators is introduced. -/
def compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    Additive (FundamentalGroup G 1) ≃+
      intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  exact (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I).toAdditive.trans
    (AddEquiv.additiveMultiplicative _)

@[simp]
theorem compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv_apply
    (γ : Additive (FundamentalGroup G 1)) :
    (compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv (G := G) I γ :
      GroupLieAlgebra I G) =
      ((compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv (G := G) I γ.toMul).toAdd :
        GroupLieAlgebra I G) :=
  rfl

/-- The additive period comparison has the same geometric normalization. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv_apply_exponentialLoop :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∀ (u : intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) (γ : Path (1 : G) 1),
      (∀ t, γ t = intrinsicComplexExponential (G := G) I
        ((t : ℝ) • (u : GroupLieAlgebra I G))) →
      compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv (G := G) I
        (Additive.ofMul (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (.mk γ))) = u := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  intro u γ hγ
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodEquiv_apply_exponentialLoop
    (G := G) I u γ hγ

/-- The concrete exponential loop represents its defining period. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv_exponentialLoop :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∀ u : intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I,
      compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv (G := G) I
        (Additive.ofMul (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          (.mk (compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop (G := G) I u)))) = u := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  intro u
  exact compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv_apply_exponentialLoop
    (G := G) I u (compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop (G := G) I u)
    (compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop_apply (G := G) I u)

end Mumford.Analytic
